name: Initials Medium
description: Initials Medium is a satin stitch Capital font. It contains the 37 glyphs :ampersand, A-Z and 0-9. In addition the ten glyphs (){}[],;.: are used to store frames. Type any letter followed by any frame (e.g. A( or B; or 7, ) to obtain a framed Capital or Number. Some manual arranging of the frame around the letter may be required.
